title: EnvironmentFile
description: Metadata for a file or directory within an environment.

path.description: Output only. The full relative path within the environment (e.g., "workspace/src/main.py").

modified.description: Output only. The modification time of the file/directory.

size_bytes.description: Output only. The size of the file/directory in bytes. NOLINT

type.description: Output only. The type of the entry.

name.description: Output only. The name of the file or directory (e.g., "main.py" or "src").

mime_type.description: Output only. The MIME type of the file (e.g., "text/python", "image/png"). Empty for directories. NOLINT

created.description: Output only. The creation time of the file/directory.
